cards.title: Handling Skipped Wells
cards.claim: A 'skipped well' (no growth bordered by growth) indicates potential error (inoculation, contamination, heterogenous resistance). For a single skipped well, retest or read the highest MIC value to avoid false susceptibility. Do not report results if more than one skipped well occurs.
conditions: Single skipped well: Retest or use highest MIC value.
required_inputs: Pattern of growth/no-growth across concentration series.
limitations: Reading the highest MIC value in a single-skip scenario may overestimate resistance if the skip was technical error.
cards.downstream_use: Data cleaning rule for handling anomalous MIC assay patterns.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
